title: Bite Sound
blurb: A single wet chomp, gone in about a quarter of a second, and one of the quietly most useful clips on any editor's timeline. Bite sounds do a very specific job: they punctuate. Drop one under a jump cut and the cut suddenly feels intentional; lay it over a zoom on somebody's face and the whole gag lands twice as hard. Cartoon editors have leaned on the chomp since the black-and-white era, and the internet inherited the habit wholesale. Short, dry and easy to layer under anything that needs to feel snapped shut.
origin: A close-mic bite or chomp sound effect, a staple of cartoon and video-edit foley.
